snippets.snippet_text: "The math: on $10,000 monthly subscription revenue, YouTube Memberships pays out $7,000 to the creator while Patreon Pro pays out $8,700 to $9,200. Over a year, the fee difference equals $20,400 in favor of Patreon on $10,000 monthly revenue."

possible_subjects: Fluxnote article comparing Patreon vs YouTube Memberships (last updated March 4, 2026): at $10,000/month subscription revenue — YouTube Memberships pays creator $7,000 (30% cut); Patreon Pro pays creator $8,700–$9,200; annual fee difference $20,400 in favor of Patreon
